set.body: Benchmark a local hand-written symmetric 3x3 reference against Gale tiny types and exercise matrix-free Helmholtz operators with explicit reusable workspaces. Add a general destination-writing symmetric solve or workspace improvement to Gale only if the public contract is reusable and measurements support it; do not add registration-specific stencils. For any adopted Gale change, land upstream, bump ScalaFIM's immutable Gale revision, and re-prove compileAll/testAll in isolation.
